summary: Router 0.42.14 addresses TM-07's next action 'plausibility checks on reports of an approved agent' (ADR-0137, proposed). Traced B3: an approved agent's heartbeat arrives over the tunnel (tunnel.dispatch TUN_HB -> json.loads -> poll.apply_heartbeat inside a broad except that answers state '' with the error text) or through the token-guarded injection endpoint (poll.handle_heartbeat). apply_heartbeat took gpu_util_pct and the VRAM numbers unchecked: impossible values reached node.gpu_util / vram_*_gib used by scheduler fit, busy detection and the baseline; a wrong type raised mid-way, leaving earlier fields applied and later ones not. Now poll.plausible_gpu_facts applies the heartbeat schema's ranges explicitly (type in int/float excluding bool, NaN and infinity out, gpu_util 0-100, VRAM 0-4 TiB) and consistency for the values that give a node room (free and ollama_proc not above total + 256 MiB; children entries individually), returning kept facts and dropped names. Used VRAM above the total is kept: it only makes the node look busier (a first version dropped it and the end-to-end suite failed, its foreign-load scenarios send used above total); apply_heartbeat applies only kept values (dropped = None = unknown, the existing no-GPU path), records node.implausible_fields (node snapshot) and logs at most every 600 s per node. Wire format unchanged; the ack for such a heartbeat is now the normal one (error is x-ignored-by-receiver). The tunnel's broad except stays for genuinely unexpected faults. No new exception path; plausible lies remain possible (documented).

findings.evidence: apply_heartbeat assigned gpu_util_pct and vram_*_mib from the agent without type or range checks; selftest_heartbeat_plausibility with poll.py and nodes.py from origin/main: 17 errors and 1 failure (subtests included; the checker does not exist there, and impossible free VRAM is used). Pre-existing since the heartbeat fields were introduced.
findings.resolution: plausible_gpu_facts with schema ranges and total consistency; dropped values are unknown and listed on the node.

tests.evidence: 6 tests: schema examples unchanged; out-of-range, wrong type, NaN, infinity dropped; free/ollama_proc above the total dropped with rounding slack accepted, used above it kept; children filtered per entry; a heartbeat with bad numbers applies the rest, lists the fields on the node and in its snapshot, logs once per interval and a good heartbeat clears the list; a free-VRAM lie above the card is not used (rejected case).

test_heartbeat_answers_over_the_tunnel now expects a heartbeat with a non-numeric vram_total_mib to be answered normally (state free, no error) with the field listed as implausible; all heartbeat and ack schema examples still conform.

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes (run separately); plus ruff check . and router.py --check router/config.example.yaml --pure
tests.evidence: 99 commands, 0 failed; includes selftest_children_vram, selftest_cpu_node, selftest_power, selftest_standby_switch, check_control_flow.
run after staging this record; synthetic node values only.

limitations: Plausible but false reports (believable load or free memory) still pass; no cross-check against observed answer times.
Other heartbeat blocks (sensors, game, memory) keep their existing handling; only the GPU numbers are range-checked here.
